style: No photography of people. Abstract 3D renders and generative/AI visuals only: glowing gradient S-mark on a pedestal, neural network node graphs, holographic geometric grids, silhouette-in-portal compositions. Consistent blue-cyan-violet gradient lighting across every image.

aspect_ratios.portraits: not used — brand uses no human photography

color_grading: cool blue-cyan-violet gradient lighting; deep navy shadows in both light and dark contexts; no warm/natural color grading
background_style: abstract 3D renders, particle/network fields, geometric grids — never real environments or stock photography
portrait_rules: no human portraits or headshots anywhere in the product; all proof/credibility signals use data, logos, or ratings instead
